runtime_findings.finding: Worker runtime accepts ROUTED, CLAIM_RESULT and CLOSE as canonical event types; missing best-effort telemetry must not erase a durable beacon-backed worker.

parallelism_findings.finding: Fixed RUN slots are bounded experiment fixtures, not the general scheduler; ordinary generic capacity belongs to the existing POOL/Work Graph path.
A six-slot CATLAB control recorded 6/6 claims, 6/6 primary completions and 6/6 reallocations, showing fixed-denominator assignment plus reallocation can complete a measured worker flow.

Historical GRID-5-100 evidence shows orchestration/admission can dominate when workers perform after reaching WORK but few reach assignment; scaling worker count is not a substitute for fixing admission.
Capacity simulations must not fabricate compatible work merely to fill requested worker counts.
